_comment: IAM Policy for the EC2 INSTANCE PROFILE (attached to the EC2 instance role, NOT to the GitHub OIDC role).
_principal: EC2 instance profile role (the role attached to the EC2 instance via IAM → Roles → <instance-role>)

_permissions_rationale.s3:GetObject: Download the backend release tarball and deploy-backend.sh from the private S3 artifacts prefix onto the EC2 instance. The SSM command calls `aws s3 cp` as the EC2 instance role, so this permission belongs here — not on the GitHub deploy role.
_permissions_rationale.ssm:*: Covered by the managed policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore — do NOT duplicate here.
_permissions_rationale.NOTE: Also attach the AWS managed policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore to this role so the SSM Agent can connect.
